capabilities.capability: One user request orchestrates online source discovery, retrieval, evidence analysis, citation verification and a structured Research Report; research runs locally with online sources fetched on demand and Ollama optional.
completion_evidence: docs/OWNER_APPROVED_ROADMAP_2026-10-25.md Research Report v1 and Next slices

slices.objective: Test a single-request report end to end, including missing or contradictory sources and citation validation.

slices.objective: Project provider coverage and degraded providers from Core's online evidence bundle into the online Research Report (currently provider_coverage_completeness=None and degraded_providers=() in copilot/online_report.py), without inventing coverage Core did not report.
acceptance: unavailable or failed sources in the bundle surface as degraded providers and missing evidence in the report; absent provider data stays explicitly unavailable, never fabricated

Canonical preflight, required CI checks and review must pass at the exact head; no gate may be weakened.

slices.objective: Expose one-request online Research Report generation through the ke-ai CLI by composing ke_client.online_research_evidence() with the online report projection, as an opt-in path needing neither an indexed corpus nor Ollama.
acceptance: a single CLI invocation with a question produces a structured Research Report JSON from the online evidence bridge (tested with a stubbed Core bridge)
bridge failure, empty bundle and over-budget cases return explicit non-fabricated errors or missing-evidence reports; temporary storage is cleaned up
existing ke-ai research behavior is unchanged
Canonical preflight, required CI checks and review must pass at the exact head; no gate may be weakened.

slices.objective: Run the Monster Energy (monster-energy-bp-one-year) acceptance case through the online-evidence report path using a deterministic recorded bundle, asserting direct/indirect separation, null-evidence retention and no false one-year-trial claim.
acceptance: the online-path report yields separate dimension conclusions with traceable certainty rationale per docs/roadmap/research_report_v1.md benchmark criteria
indirect caffeine/coffee/soda evidence is never labelled direct Monster causality, and missing direct one-year evidence is stated
fixture is a recorded bundle; no network or Ollama use in tests
Canonical preflight, required CI checks and review must pass at the exact head; no gate may be weakened.

slices.objective: Validate knowledge_engine_ai/copilot/online_evidence_adapter.py against knowledge-engine-core's own committed ke-online-evidence/v1 golden bundle (tests/fixtures/online_evidence/bundle.json and its contents/ directory, pinned at knowledge-engine-core commit 02da1f2666e643e6e6f2a42bc93f53ae57c1b977), instead of relying only on hand-authored test payloads that can drift from Core's real contract. Every existing online-evidence test in this repo (test_online_evidence_adapter.py, test_online_report.py, test_cli_online_report.py, test_online_report_monster_acceptance.py) constructs its own bundle JSON by hand; none of them parse Core's actual exported fixture, so a silent field-level drift between the two independently maintained implementations would currently go undetected.
acceptance: a byte-identical copy of knowledge-engine-core's tests/fixtures/online_evidence/bundle.json and its contents/ directory is vendored under knowledge-engine-ai's tests/fixtures/online_evidence/, with a short header or adjacent note recording the exact knowledge-engine-core commit SHA it was copied from

a new test loads the vendored fixture and content files from disk and asserts parse_content_checked_online_evidence() accepts it unmodified, preserving every retrieved, failed and unavailable source exactly as Core recorded it

the same test asserts build_online_research_report() projects the parsed fixture into a ResearchReport without raising, and that every failed or unavailable source in the fixture appears in the report's missing_evidence
the test uses only the vendored files on disk: no network access and no pre-ingested corpus
docs/roadmap/research_report_v1.md records the vendored fixture path and its source commit as the cross-repo compatibility check this slice adds
Canonical preflight, required CI checks and review must pass at the exact head; no gate may be weakened.
runner_requirements: python 3.11+ with the repository's locked dev dependencies installed
no network access: the vendored fixture only
free local libraries already used by the repository only

slices.objective: Wire the online-evidence Research Report path (knowledge_engine_ai/copilot/online_evidence_adapter.py and online_report.py) into run_research_question() as an explicit, guarded, opt-in mode, instead of leaving it reachable only through the standalone `ke-ai online-report` CLI command disconnected from the orchestrator. This closes docs/roadmap/research_report_v1.md's own recorded next step ('guarded Web one-request integration') and moves the capability's stated outcome -- one user request orchestrating online evidence into a structured report -- from a side CLI command toward the actual orchestrated request path other callers, including knowledge-engine-web, already use.
acceptance: run_research_question() (or a thin wrapper beside it that existing callers can adopt without modification) accepts an explicit opt-in parameter or mode that, when set, produces a ResearchReport via the online-evidence adapter/report path instead of the indexed local-corpus path; the parameter defaults to current behavior and no existing caller's behavior or output changes unless it passes the new opt-in explicitly

before merging, verify against knowledge-engine-web's actual current structured-report consumption code (not assumption) that the opt-in result's shape is compatible with what Web already expects, or document precisely why it is not yet wired to Web and what would need to change there; do not assume cross-repository compatibility

a regression test exercises the opt-in path end to end with a stubbed Core bridge, covering a successful bundle, a bundle containing failed or unavailable sources, and bridge failure, each producing the correct ResearchReport or an explicit non-fabricated error with temporary storage cleaned up
the existing default local-corpus/GQR path, its Research-ISA close gates, and its existing tests are unchanged in behavior
docs/roadmap/research_report_v1.md's status note is updated to record this integration and the actual Web-contract verification performed
Canonical preflight, required CI checks and review must pass at the exact head; no gate may be weakened.
